title: The Christmas Calendar
description: When Emily, a struggling baker in a small town, receives a handmade Christmas calendar from a secret admirer, the local residents become obsessed with finding out the identity of the sender.

title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
description: A city manager recruits the help of a childhood friend to save his town's Christmas charity event, while she attempts to set him up with her close friend.

title: Have We Met This Christmas
description: After a car wreck leaves her with amnesia, a real estate exec recovers at a small town inn at Christmas. Unaware of their past connection, she falls for the innkeeper's son - until her returning memories jeopardize their budding romance.

title: Silver Bells at Christmas
description: Determined to save her mother's Christmas shop, Ginny must choose between protecting the past she loves and embracing a future that could change her heart forever.

title: A Brush With Christmas
description: Disheartened and struggling to find time for her art, Charlotte throws out her latest painting, only to discover that it has been anonymously submitted to the Christmas art festival.

title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

title: A Kindhearted Christmas
description: To capture the holiday spirit, Jaime anonymously gives gifts to those in need. Word spreads and people in town wonder who this "Secret Santa" is. She remains anonymous and meets Scott. Jamie tries to keep her secret and pursue a new romance.

title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
description: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

title: A Very Arctic Christmas
description: Stranded in an arctic town during Christmastime, a single father and his 20-year-old daughter meet a wildlife conservationist who helps them navigate the frozen wilderness.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.

title: Let It Snow
description: An executive examines her company's new property and prepares a presentation to transform the rustic lodge into a new hot spot. She tries to ignore the lodge's festive celebrations during her stay, but an unexpected romance changes her heart.

title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
description: Rival real estate agents both make the same wish during the first snow of the winter: to win the most coveted listing in town. As the business competitors begrudgingly work together, they learn the house comes with a special commission: love.

title: Christmas Angel
description: Ashley gets a new job from her neighbor Nick as his assistant in the best work: being a Secret Santa. Nick has sworn her to secrecy, which includes her new friend Will, a reporter in search of a Christmas story for his magazine.

title: Pencil Me in for Christmas
description: An aspiring illustrator teams up with a demanding author to work on a children's book. As they create their Christmas-themed project in a nostalgic small town, they find themselves rediscovering the holiday spirit.

title: A Lot Like Christmas
description: Jessica owns the most popular Christmas tree lot in Hudson Springs, but when big-city marketing executive Clay Moore moves a big box chain store into the area and starts selling trees, Jessica finds her business in jeopardy.

title: A Little Women's Christmas
description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

title: Christmas at the Inn
description: Beth Green, a devoted café owner, returns to her hometown of Snow Ridge to help her parents host the town's most cherished tradition, the annual Yuletide Potluck, a holiday potluck that welcomes military families and veterans who might otherwise spend Christmas alone. At her parents' cozy inn, Beth meets Jack Evans, a civil engineer with the military, assigned to oversee projects at the local base over Christmas.

title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
description: When a girl quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, her family discovers that some of God's greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness.

title: A Christmas Less Traveled
description: An old audio cassette of her dad's voice sends a woman on a journey to retrace her family's most memorable moments. Along the way, she meets a man who offers her a generous payment in exchange for a ride to close the most important deal of his life.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.
